dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "main.py"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt with the latest stable version of pyspark (3.5.1) as detected in imports. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base image, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, copies application code, and sets default command to run main.py. This provides a minimal production-ready container for Python applications using pyspark.
